news.title: University announces 2026 recipients of annual teaching awards
news.summary_en: The University of Kansas has announced 15 faculty members from the Lawrence and KU Medical Center campuses as recipients of KU’s annual teaching awards. They will be honored at a public reception Oct. 13 at the Jayhawk Welcome Center.

news.title: Polish naturalists saved European bison from extinction, research reveals
news.summary_en: In a new scholarly article, Nathan Wood, associate professor of history at the University of Kansas, describes how after soldiers and poachers killed the last free European bison, Polish naturalists worked with international organizations following World War I to revive the species from the few animals scattered on estates and zoos across the continent.

news.title: KU student-designed mural reflects community, belonging in Watson Library
news.summary_en: KU Libraries collaborated with students from the Department of Design for a new mural in The Kettle in Watson Library. The public is invited to an opening reception at 4 p.m. Sept. 24 to celebrate the work and partnership.

news.title: New KU initiative recognizes community partnerships driving action across Kansas
news.summary_en: The University of Kansas Office of Community Impact has announced 26 inaugural champions and hubs that support community-engaged scholarship and collaboration across Kansas.

news.title: Military aircraft to fly over KU campus Thursday, Friday in advance of football game
news.summary_en: Military jets will fly over the University of Kansas campus Thursday, Sept. 3, and Friday, Sept. 4, in advance of Friday’s football game between KU and Long Island University.

news.title: KU alumna, NASA astronaut Loral O’Hara to headline KU Reads event Oct. 8
news.summary_en: The University of Kansas will welcome home one of its own this fall when KU alumna and NASA astronaut Loral O'Hara returns to Lawrence for a public event celebrating the 2026-27 KU Reads: A Common Book Experience selection.

news.title: KU law professor traces legal history of the kiss
news.summary_en: Andrew Torrance, a professor of law at the University of Kansas, has published research on how kissing, one of the most basic human acts and a sign of love, has been viewed alternately as property that can be stolen, a contract, a criminal act or as agency over one’s own body. His article was published in the journal Evolution and Human Behavior.

news.title: University Honors Program announces five additions to Honors Faculty Fellow cohort
news.summary_en: The University Honors Program has welcomed five KU faculty members to its cohort of Honors Faculty Fellows, who join six continuing fellows as well as one returning fellow for the fall 2026 semester.
